title: Debt Recovery Paralegal
description:
Amazing opportunity to join a full-service law firm. I'm currently assisting a close client, a well-established, forward-thinking law firm, on an opportunity for a Paralegal to join its Commercial Debt Litigation team in Manchester.

This is a great role for someone with prior debt recovery experience who is looking to take the next step in a supportive, fast-paced environment with clear progression opportunities.

The role:

You'll manage a varied caseload of debt recovery matters, working across the full lifecycle of claims. This includes:
- Drafting letters of claim and reviewing agreements
- Profiling debtors and assessing recovery prospects
- Negotiating settlements and liaising with clients
- Issuing proceedings, entering judgment and progressing enforcement action
- Managing files, billing and reporting

What the firm is looking for:
- Essential: previous debt recovery experience
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Confident communication and negotiation skills
- Ability to manage your own caseload

What's on offer?
- Hybrid working (minimum 2 days in office)
- 25 days' holiday (rising with service) + buy/sell option
- Private medical, life insurance & income protection
- Enhanced family leave and pension
- Additional perks including wellbeing support and retail discounts

If you have debt recovery experience and want to build your career in a progressive firm, get in touch asap.

title: Finance assistant - R2R
description:
Finance Process Specialist - R2 R

South Manchester Hybrid Working

About the Company

Are you a part-qualified accountant looking for greater exposure, responsibility and career progression?

We're working with a global organisation with a strong and growing finance function, offering the opportunity to work in a collaborative, international environment. As the business continues to expand, they're investing in their people and creating opportunities for ambitious finance professionals to develop their skills and progress their careers.

The Role

As a Finance Process Specialist, you'll join the Record-to-Report (R2 R) team, supporting key finance processes across the wider business.

Key responsibilities include:
- Supporting month-end and year-end close
- Processing transactions and completing reconciliations
- Managing finance queries and internal stakeholders
- Maintaining financial data and controls
- Supporting audit and compliance
- Identifying process improvement opportunities
- Working with teams across different functions and countries

Why Join?

A great opportunity for a part-qualified accountant looking to move beyond a purely transactional role.
- Strong career progression and development
- Study support
- Global finance exposure
- Broader R2 R and month-end experience
- Hybrid working - 3 days office, 2 from home
- Flexible start times
- South Manchester location
- Growing team with development opportunities

Interested?

If you're part-qualified and ready for your next step, this is a great opportunity to broaden your experience and build a long-term career in a global finance function.

Apply now or contact Oliver Gibson at Robert Walters for more information.

Robert Walters Operations Limited is an employment business and employment agency and welcomes applications from all candidates

title: Plot Sales Paralegal
company: The Eventus Recruitment Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Eventus Legal are seeking a Plot Sales Paralegal to join a well-established, award-winning law firm based in Hale, Cheshire. This is a full-time, permanent job position offering a salary of up to £30,000 depending on experience, alongside an employee bonus scheme of up to 10% of salary, a healthcare package with 24/7 GP access and contributions towards dental treatment, glasses and physiotherapy, company pension, death in service cover, Pure Gym membership and a paid day off for your birthday. This opportunity has arisen through internal progression, allowing for a new an available position within the plot sales team.Role Responsibilities

Joining the Residential Property team, the Plot Sales Paralegal will support the efficient progression of plot sales and wider residential property matters. Key responsibilities will include:
- Drafting, reviewing and organising legal documents relating to residential property transactions
- Managing case files and ensuring documentation is accurate, complete and kept up to date
- Liaising with clients, solicitors and external parties to progress matters and obtain required information
- Preparing correspondence, reports and schedules using Microsoft Office
- Supporting the team with case preparation, document management and day-to-day workflow
- Maintaining confidentiality and high standards of client care throughout each matter

Person Specification

This opportunity will suit a detail-focused paralegal with residential property experience and a particular interest in plot sales work. Applications are welcomed from candidates who can demonstrate the following:
- Previous experience working as a Paralegal or Legal Assistant with experience of plot sales work
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent organisation and time management, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook, with the ability to learn legal case management systems
- A proactive, self-motivated approach and the ability to work both independently and as part of a busy team
- A strong commitment to accurate work and high standards of client care

Benefits and Rewards

The firm offers a broad employee benefits package alongside the opportunity to develop within an established property practice. The successful Plot Sales Paralegal will also benefit from:
- Salary of up to £30,000 depending on experience
- Employee bonus scheme providing up to an additional 10% of salary annually, subject to terms and conditions
- Healthcare package providing 24/7 GP access
- £100 towards dental treatment per annum
- £100 towards glasses per annum
- £250 towards physiotherapy per annum
- Free Annual eye tests
- Free Annual hearing tests
- Death in service insurance paying four times salary
- Company pension
- Pet insurance for cats and dogs, subject to conditions
- Counselling service
- Monthly office massages of 15 minutes per person
- Pure Gym membership
- Annual flu jab
- A paid day off for your birthday
- Netflix/Spotify/Amazon Prime/Apple News+ subscriptions

About the Law Firm

This award-winning, Legal 500-recognised law firm has a strong reputation across property and wider commercial legal services. The firm is known for high-quality work, a client-focused approach and a commitment to developing its people. Internal progression is actively supported, and this vacancy has arisen because an existing member of the plot sales team has progressed into a training contract. The Plot Sales Paralegal will join a growing property practice with exposure to residential property, property development and related plot sales work in Hale, Cheshire.

Next Steps

Apply now to be considered for this career-enhancing job opportunity. Alternatively, for a confidential discussion about this Plot Sales Paralegal job, please send your CV to Sonia Idris at the Eventus Recruitment Group or call for a confidential discussion. Due to the high volume of applications, if you have not heard from us within ten days, unfortunately you have not been shortlisted on this occasion.

If this job isn't quite right for you but you are looking for a new position, please contact me at the details above for a confidential discussion on your career.

The Eventus Recruitment Group are award-winning recruitment specialists operating in the Legal, Finance and Financial Planning sectors across the UK. Please note, the years' experience and/or salary are listed in our advertisements as a guide. We are happy to consider applications from all candidates who are able to demonstrate the skills necessary to fulfil the role. As an equal opportunities employer we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Our privacy policy can be found on the bottom of our website.
